$comment: Resolution, texel density, encoding and check thresholds for the material library (docs/ART.md §3). Each material tiles at its tiling.tileM metres (default tileM) (ART.md §3 'Tiled materials repeat at 1 m or 2 m'; 'a 512 texture covers 2 x 2 m at 256 px/m; a 1K hero texture covers 2 x 2 m at 512 px/m'). tests/materials.test.js reads this file.

periodRecurrence.note: 2 m tiles: knot-scale detail (log luminance band-passed to 4-24 mm) must not recur one metre along either axis; wood floors must be 2 m tiles

presetUse.note: a floor family's presets allowed on floors keep their tinted median inside the family band; darker or lighter ones carry params.tint.presetUse without 'floor'

decodedLimits.note: every decoded base color texel of a non-transmissive material is inside the hard limits (build.py clamps before encoding and tightens until it is)

changes: 2026-09-23 WP-P0-05b: tiers become the ART.md §3 classes (regular 256, tall 384, hero 512 px/m) over tileM = 2 m tiles (ART.md §3 'a 512 texture covers 2 x 2 m at 256 px/m'); was hero 1024 / regular 512 px/m over 1 m placeholders.
checks.normals tightened to WP-P0-11's art-metrics limits (docs/ART.md-derived, tools/art-metrics/standard.mjs NORMALS): mean length error 0.03 -> 0.02, p99 0.12 -> 0.08.
detail: new, 256 px close-up normal maps tiling every 0.1 m (fabric, leather, cardboard).

2026-09-23 WP-P0-05c: no copied tiles. The default tile is 1 m (ART.md §3 allows 1 m or 2 m) and a texture's size is texelDensity x its tile (256 px over 1 m, 512 over 2 m); 'repeat' tiling is gone (it packed n x n copies of a scan into a tile); checks.selfCopy fails any base color within 1.5 codes (or 0.35 of the difference at an unrelated shift) of itself shifted by 1/2 ... 1/8 of the tile (WP-P0-11c uses 1 code at 1/2 and 1/4).

2026-09-23 WP-P0-05c art check: the woods are 2 m tiles again, laid from whole boards with staggered joints (tiling 'planks'); checks.periodRecurrence fails a 2 m tile whose knot-scale detail recurs every metre. Synthesis can jitter its block sizes (no fixed block period), overlap more, feather its cuts and even out local contrast first.

2026-09-23 WP-P0-05c re-check: base color clamped inside the hard limits before encoding, tightened until every decoded texel is inside them; params.tint.presetUse restricts a preset to uses (oak 'smoked' is accent/furniture only), and floor-family presets allowed on floors stay in band.
